GoldCheetah gold trend momentum strategy

GoldCheetah waits for XAUUSD to break out after consolidation. Entry requires both price structure and momentum to qualify. Each trade opens with a stop and has its own exit.

GoldCheetahPartner strategy
01

Trading logic

During consolidation, the EA tracks the range boundaries and the strength of a possible breakout. It trades in the breakout direction only once the momentum filter also qualifies. Each position has its own entry, take-profit or stop-loss, and exit.

02

Risks & boundaries

A breakout can reverse back into the range, and successive false signals can compound losses. The source gives a per-trade stop setting of 1%–5%. Gaps and slippage can affect the fill even when the stop is set at entry.

03

Operating requirements

The source describes an ECN account trading XAUUSD, averaging about one or two trades a day. The system waits when no setup qualifies. Licensing and execution arrangements are specific to the strategy partner.
